name: food-around-work-recommendation
description: Food recommendation system with MCP integration

scripts.predeploy: npm run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); fs.mkdirSync('out',{recursive:true}); fs.writeFileSync('out/.nojekyll',''); if(!fs.existsSync('out/config.json')&&fs.existsSync('public/config.json')){fs.copyFileSync('public/config.json','out/config.json'); console.log('Copied config.json to out/config.json');} else if(fs.existsSync('out/config.json')){console.log('config.json already exists in out/');} else{console.warn('WARNING: public/config.json not found');}"
